storyTagline: A fourth straight title for Dorren Skura, three records for Ryland Maxwell and a rookie Super Bowl MVP in Atlanta.

stories.headline: Four Straight for Skura, and Atlanta Has Never Looked Better
stories.dek: The Falcons went 15-2, beat the Bengals in Super Bowl CXLIV and gave Dorren Skura his 60th title behind a record season from Ryland Maxwell.

stories.headline: Maxwell Breaks His Own Record, and Then Some
stories.dek: 2,617 rushing yards, 39 rushing touchdowns and a 237-yard game: Ryland Maxwell rewrote three lines of the record board in one season.

stories.headline: Adam Arrives: A Rookie Takes the Biggest Stage
stories.dek: Apollo Adam caught 85 passes for 1,654 yards in his first season and left Super Bowl CXLIV as its Most Valuable Player.

stories.headline: Larienne Stays on the Field, and Atlanta Pulls Away
stories.dek: Orlando Larienne played all 20 games after missing 5 a year ago. This time Chance Woodrum, now with 6 rings, was the one who missed time.

stories.headline: Record Watch: Settle Closes In on Junior
stories.dek: K'Lavon Settle made 208 tackles and sits 109 short of Mose Junior's 2,862. A new card, Juwann Gilman, is 10 behind him.

stories.headline: Old Hands, New Cards
stories.dek: Kahzin Heath in Denver, Camaron Knight and Juwann Gilman in Arizona and Linval Laulile in Pittsburgh joined the card pool with long careers already written.

stories.headline: Tillery Takes the MVP in His Second Season
stories.dek: Jimmy Tillery threw for 4,183 yards and 44 touchdowns for the Jets, while Kalif Suh and Malakai Sawyer kept adding to long careers.

stories.headline: Cincinnati Joins the List
stories.dek: The Bengals have now met Dorren Skura in 3 Super Bowls and lost all 3, the first two to his Vikings.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Sherman Brandson
vault.text: The General never flinched. Career Legacy 12,933, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Rondale Ikarras
vault.text: Flashy, loud, unstoppable, and he knew it. He was that guy. Career Legacy 12,052, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · God Johnson
vault.text: He changed his name to God. Then he earned it. Career Legacy 11,965, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ian Finney
vault.text: The first superstar. The Infinity Man. Career Legacy 10,817, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Levante Hopkins
vault.text: The quiet one who did the dirty work. Career Legacy 10,794, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Dennis Baylon
vault.text: Seven trips to the Super Bowl. Seven rings. Not one loss. Career Legacy 9,872, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Cairo Asanjh
vault.text: Some players chase records. Cairo Asanjh chased Ian Finney. Career Legacy 9,842, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jackson Wardell Kline
vault.text: Tyrion Kline's son did not live in anyone's shadow. He built his own. Career Legacy 9,604, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Charlie John
vault.text: Seven straight Super Bowls. Charlie John was there for every one of them. Career Legacy 9,494, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Zander Kolar
vault.text: Some defensive linemen are measured in sacks. Zander Kolar was measured in tackles. Career Legacy 9,006, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Wayne Wilson
vault.text: Four hundred thirty-one games. Nobody in this league has played longer. Career Legacy 8,966, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lukas Russell
vault.text: The Running Man started fast and never slowed down. Career Legacy 8,857, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jayon Queen
vault.text: Two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Only one other player in this league has ever matched that. Career Legacy 8,787, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Nick Bolton
vault.text: One of the originals, and he never stopped tackling. Career Legacy 8,674, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ray Waller
vault.text: Never count out a man whose nickname is a promise. Career Legacy 8,472, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jahmyr Gibbs
vault.text: Mr. Incredible was here at the start, and he set the bar high. Career Legacy 8,424, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Bilal Tolbert
vault.text: No individual trophies. Four rings. And a sack record nobody has caught. Career Legacy 8,404, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyrone Baugh
vault.text: Seven seasons, seven championships, and Tyrone Baugh has a ring for every one of them. Career Legacy 8,387, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lloyd Queen
vault.text: Some linemen hunt quarterbacks. Lloyd Queen hunted everybody else. Career Legacy 7,944, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Mose Junior
vault.text: Some players chase rings. Mose Junior chased ball carriers. Career Legacy 7,788, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Amani Bryant
vault.text: The best quarterback never to win a ring. Career Legacy 7,787, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lamar Jackson
vault.text: The league never had to explain who he was. He was just Him. Career Legacy 7,685, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyler Pacheco
vault.text: Tyler Pacheco never needed the big play. He needed the ball, and he got it. Career Legacy 7,383, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Akiem Bouye
vault.text: Akiem the Dream was there at the beginning. Career Legacy 7,377, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Michael Wilson
vault.text: Wayne's brother, and nobody's afterthought. Career Legacy 8,343, Y79 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Dan Mosley
vault.text: 2,658 tackles from a defensive back. Read that again. Career Legacy 7,747, Y79 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jakeem Friend
vault.text: Linemen do not win trophies. Jakeem Friend won seven rings instead. Career Legacy 11,433, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jason Macleone
vault.text: One look at Scary Jerry and you understood the name. Career Legacy 7,566, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Pharoah Hunter
vault.text: The other receiver in the Vikings dynasty was never anybody's second option. Career Legacy 7,558, Y80 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Abraham Ward Jr
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game, every game, for 236 games. Career Legacy 7,564, Y82 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Malakai Sawyer
vault.text: Some backs have a great season. Malakai Sawyer keeps having them. Career Legacy 7,388, Y84 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Von Horsted
vault.text: Fifteen seasons, one team, and a tackle on almost every series. Career Legacy 7,368, Y84 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Juwann Gilman
vault.text: Thirteen seasons in Arizona, and almost twelve tackles every time he takes the field. Career Legacy 7,557, Y85 class.
